description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 31.01.2022 to 06.02.2022
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It is a regulatory instrument issued under the authority of the Customs Ordinance, making it a legal/regulatory matter. The content involves setting and modifying official exchange rates for the calculation of customs payments, which falls under the category of regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.
